summary: FB Financial Corporation filed a routine Form 8-K on September 21, 2026, under Items 8.01 and 9.01, disclosing that it made available a fixed-income investor presentation dated September 2026 to be used in meetings with investors and analysts. The exhibit supersedes prior presentation materials. No transaction, stake, price, premium, or advisor is disclosed. This is ordinary investor-relations disclosure rather than a special situation. Watch for any future strategic announcements, capital actions, or credit updates that may accompany such presentations, but no risk-arb angle applies here.
